_comment: Sites whose page cache should be kept warm. Public URLs only - never put credentials in this file. Add a client by appending an entry; nothing else needs to change.

sites.name: eliminatis
sites.reason: WPMU Quantum plan: ~3.5x slower PHP than our other sites, 1h cache TTL, and only the homepage is preloaded. Cold render is 1.4-2.3s vs 0.09s warm, so the first visitor to each page each hour - often a paid ad click - eats the slow path.
